'''Prefect''' was a rank in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Imperial Sector Police]]. Prefects were in charge of a [[Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters|station house]] and were collectively known as the prefecture. A long time [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] and well regarded prefect was [[Pol Haus]].
